query_text: Need a mobile calculator app that takes my gross monthly salary and works out my actual take-home pay, because I always forget to account for taxes and deductions and end up surprised every payday. I want to punch in my gross amount, pick my filing status and a couple of standard deduction types, and immediately see the net figure broken down so I know exactly what I am working with before I plan my budget.

Build a currency converter app for my phone that pulls live exchange rates so I can type in any amount in one currency and instantly see what it is worth in another, because manually looking up rates every time I travel or shop from overseas stores is a real pain. The app should let me pick from a list of major currencies, show the converted amount right away, and display when the rate was last updated so I know the number is fresh.

Build a body-frame BMI calculator app for my phone that goes beyond the basic BMI number and actually adjusts the result based on whether I have a small, medium, or large frame, since standard BMI always feels off for my build. I want to enter my height, weight, and wrist circumference to figure out my frame size, and then see a BMI result that is calibrated to that frame along with a simple note on what the number means.

Make a fuel efficiency converter app for my phone that flips between MPG and liters per 100km so I stop getting confused when I look at European car specs or rental comparisons. I want to type in either value and get the other one instantly, plus maybe a quick comparison row showing a few common benchmarks like city driving versus highway so I have some context for whether a number is actually good or not.

Need a lumber board feet calculator app for my phone that lets me enter the thickness, width, and length of each piece of wood and instantly tells me the total board feet, because I always mess up the formula at the lumber yard and end up buying either too much or too little. It should let me add multiple pieces to a list so I can tally up a whole project order before I even get to the checkout.

Need a road trip fuel cost estimator app for my phone that takes my trip distance, my car's fuel efficiency, and the current gas price and spits out roughly how much I should budget for gas, so I can stop guessing and actually plan my drive properly. I want to be able to swap between kilometers and miles, and maybe split the total across the number of people riding along so everyone knows their share upfront.

Create a cooking measurement converter app for my phone that lets me switch between US cups, tablespoons, teaspoons, and ounces on one side and grams, milliliters, and liters on the other, because following American recipes when I only have a kitchen scale is such a headache. I want a clean input where I pick the ingredient type like flour or water, enter the US amount, and get the metric equivalent right away so I can just cook.

Build a retirement withdrawal calculator app for my phone that lets me enter my total savings, my expected annual spending, and a withdrawal rate I pick, then shows me how many years that money will last before it runs out, because I keep seeing different rules of thumb online and I just want a simple tool to check my own numbers. It should also show a year-by-year breakdown so I can see which year things start getting tight.

Create a time zone meeting scheduler tool for my phone that lets me pick a meeting time in my local time and see what hour that is in several other cities at once, because I waste so much time doing mental math and then still get it wrong when setting up calls with people in different countries. I want to add a few cities I commonly work with, set a proposed time, and instantly see whether it falls during normal working hours for everyone involved.

Build a photo print quality calculator app for my phone that lets me enter a photo's pixel dimensions and the print size I want, then tells me the resulting DPI and whether the print will look sharp or blurry, because I keep ordering prints and ending up disappointed when the image looks soft. I want the result to clearly say something like good quality or too low so I know whether to bother printing at that size or find a higher-res version first.

Need a knitting yarn estimator app for my phone that helps me figure out how many yards of yarn I need for a project, because I always either run out mid-scarf or end up with way too many leftover skeins. I want to enter the type of project like a hat, scarf, or sweater, my needle size, and my yarn weight, and get a yardage estimate along with how many skeins to buy based on the skein size I am working with.

Create a BPM and time signature helper app for my phone that lets me tap a button to detect the tempo of a song I am listening to, and then shows me the note lengths in milliseconds for that BPM at whatever time signature I pick, because I always struggle to sync my loops and effects correctly when I am making music on the go. It should show the delay times for common note values like quarter notes and eighth notes so I can just copy the numbers straight into my settings.

Need a book reading tracker app for my phone where I can add the books I am currently reading, enter how many pages I finished today, and watch a little progress bar fill up as I get closer to the end. I like the idea of seeing my reading history laid out so I can look back at all the books I finished over the year, and it would be great if I could set a daily page goal and get a small nudge on the home screen of the app reminding me how close I am.

Create a screen time logger app for my phone where I can manually jot down which category of app I just spent time on, like social media, games, work, or news, and roughly how many minutes I was on it, so I can get a sense of where my phone time actually goes each day. I want a simple way to tap a category, enter a duration, and then see a little daily summary showing which buckets are eating up the most of my time.

Create a personal cash flow daily log app for my phone where I can quickly jot down money coming in and money going out throughout the day, tag each entry with a simple category like food, transport, or income, and then see a running total for the day so I always know whether I am in the green or red. I want to be able to flip through past days easily and see a simple summary at the top of the app showing my net for the current week.

Need a symptom and medication side effect journal app for my phone where I can log how I feel each day alongside what medications I took, so I can actually bring useful notes to my doctor instead of trying to remember everything from the past two weeks. I want to jot down a symptom with a quick severity rating, tie it to a specific medication if I think they are related, and see a simple timeline of entries so patterns are easy to spot.

Build a baby feeding and diaper change log app for my phone where I can tap a big easy button whenever a feeding or diaper change happens and quickly note the time and a few details like feeding duration or diaper type, because trying to remember the last feed time when I am sleep-deprived is impossible. I want the home screen of the app to always show how many hours ago the last feeding was and a count of diaper changes for the day so I can answer the pediatrician's questions without digging through my memory.

A social interaction diary app for my phone where I can write a quick note after hanging out with someone, rate how energized or drained the interaction left me on a simple scale, and log who I spent time with, so I can start noticing which relationships leave me feeling good versus which ones are always exhausting. The app should let me look back at entries by person so I can see a pattern over time for each relationship in my life.

A daily outfit and weather log app for my phone that lets me record what I wore each morning and match it to the weather that day, like temperature and whether it rained, so I can look back and figure out which outfits actually worked for which conditions. The tracker should keep a running list of past entries so I can quickly reference what I wore last time it was cold and rainy and decide whether to repeat the combo or try something different.

Need a focus session logger app for my phone where I can start a timer when I sit down to do deep work, label what I am working on, and then save the session when I am done so I can see how many focused hours I actually put in each week. I want the app to show a simple list of past sessions with the topic and duration so I can look back at a week and see whether I am being as productive as I think or just telling myself I worked a lot.

Create a daily new words tracker app for my phone where I can add any new word I picked up that day in whatever language I am studying, jot down a quick example sentence, and then flip through all my saved words later to review them. I want the app to show me how many new words I have added each day so I can keep a streak going, and a simple list view where I can tap any word to see my notes and example sentence again.

Create a home chore habit log app for my phone where I can set up a list of regular chores like vacuuming, doing laundry, or cleaning the bathroom, mark each one as done when I finish it, and see which ones I have been skipping for too long. I want the app to show me the last time I did each chore so I never have to wonder whether I already mopped this week or whether it has been two weeks since I cleaned the bathroom.

Build a sleep quality log app for my phone where every morning I can rate how well I slept on a simple scale, add a short note about anything that might have affected my sleep like stress or late coffee, and track what time I went to bed and woke up. I want the app to show a weekly summary so I can see whether my sleep quality is trending up or down and figure out what is helping or hurting my rest over time.

Need a daily steps and active minutes recorder app for my phone where I can manually enter my step count and how many minutes I spent moving around each day, since I do not always have my fitness tracker synced and just want a simple place to log the numbers myself. I want to see a weekly chart showing my activity so I can notice when I have had a lazy stretch and motivate myself to move more the following days.

A LinkedIn connection message personalizer tool for my phone where I type in a few quick details about the person I want to connect with, like their job title, company, or something we have in common, and the app generates a short personalized message I can copy and send right away. I want a few different tone options like friendly, professional, or casual so I can pick the one that fits the situation, and the whole thing should fit comfortably on a single mobile screen so I can use it on the go.

Create a thank-you note template generator app for my phone where I pick the occasion, like a gift, a favor, or a job referral, and the app gives me a few ready-made note templates I can tap through and copy. I want to be able to tweak the wording a little before sending, and maybe pick a warm or formal tone depending on who I'm writing to.

Make a mobile app that helps me put together an apology message when I've messed up with someone, where I describe what happened and the app helps me shape it into something that sounds genuine and not defensive. It should also give me a quick feel for whether the tone comes across too cold or too over-the-top so I can fix it before sending.

Make a gift recommendation tool for my phone where I answer a few quick questions about the person I'm buying for, like whether they're introverted or outgoing and what kind of things they enjoy, and it suggests a handful of gift ideas that actually match their personality. I want the suggestions to feel personal, not just generic best-sellers.

Need a mobile app that helps me make little introduction cards for guests at a party, where I type in each person's name and a fun fact or two and the app puts it into a neat card format people can read. It would be great if each card had a consistent look so guests can scan them quickly during the event and actually start conversations.

Make a long-distance friendship planner app for my phone where my friend and I can browse activity ideas we can do together even from different cities, like watching the same movie at the same time or playing a quick online game, and mark which ones we want to try. It should feel like a shared list we can both update and tap through one idea at a time.

Create a caption and emoji generator app for my phone where I type in what a photo is about, pick a vibe like funny or heartfelt, and it spits out a few caption options with matching emojis I can copy straight to my post. I want to be able to tap through different options quickly and pick the one that fits best.

Need a mobile app that helps me plan out a tricky conversation before I have it, where I describe the situation and what I want to say and the app helps me organize it into a clear script with an opening, the main point, and a calm way to close. It would help so much to walk in with my thoughts in order and not ramble when things get awkward.

Build a prep kit app for my phone that helps me get ready before a networking event, where I can jot down the names and background of people I want to meet and the app organizes everything into a quick one-screen view I can glance at before walking in. It should also let me add a few talking points or questions I want to bring up so I feel confident and prepared.

Make a holiday card message creator app for my phone where I pick the holiday and the relationship, like for a coworker or a grandparent, and the app gives me a few warm message options I can customize and copy. I want to be able to pick between a heartfelt tone and something more lighthearted so the message feels right for each person on my list.

Build a team-building activity suggester app for my phone where I enter some basics like how many people are in the group and whether we prefer indoor or outdoor stuff, and the app gives me a list of concrete activity ideas to browse one at a time. I want each suggestion to include a short description of how it works so I can pitch it to the team without having to do extra research.

A countdown timer app for my phone built around the excitement of an upcoming show, concert, or event ticket, where the main screen shows a big beautiful number ticking down the days and hours in a style that feels more like a poster than a plain clock. The whole vibe should feel anticipatory and a little theatrical, with the event name and date displayed in a way I'd actually want to screenshot and share.

Build a retirement countdown app for my phone that shows how many years and months I have left until I hit retirement age, with a visual feel that is calm and a little reflective rather than stressful, like soft tones and a clean layout that makes the number feel meaningful instead of alarming. I want it to feel like a gentle reminder of the chapter ahead, not a ticking clock bearing down on me.

Create a sports season opening countdown app for my phone that counts down to the first game of the season with the kind of energy and color that actually matches the sport, so it feels exciting to open every day. I want to pick the team and sport, and have the countdown displayed in a bold, fan-worthy style with the team colors setting the whole mood.

A study countdown app for my phone focused on bar or board exam prep, where the timer counts down to exam day and the feel is focused and serious but not so grim that it stresses me out more. I want the main screen to show days remaining in a clean, minimal style that feels like a study journal, with a small space to jot my daily intention or goal so each day feels like a step forward.

Make a visa and immigration deadline tracker app for my phone that keeps all my important dates in one place, like application deadlines, status check dates, and renewal windows, displayed in a calm and organized way that is easy to read at a glance. I want the design to feel composed and trustworthy, like something that helps me stay on top of things rather than panic about them.

Build a sobriety milestone counter app for my phone that tracks clean days since a chosen start date and shows the number in a way that feels warm, personal, and worth celebrating, with milestone markers at meaningful points like 30 days, 90 days, and a year. I want the whole thing to feel like a quiet source of pride to open every morning, with a tone that is gentle and affirming.

Build a military deployment return countdown app for my phone where I set the expected homecoming date and the app shows the days counting down in a way that feels loving and meaningful, with a warm color palette and a place to write a short message or note to look forward to. I want the feel to be hopeful and personal, not cold or functional, since this is something you open every single day while waiting.

A lease renewal tracker app for my phone that keeps an eye on when my apartment lease is up for renewal and shows the countdown in a clean, organized way so I never get caught off guard by a deadline. I want the design to feel tidy and domestic, maybe a little homey, with room to note key dates like when I need to give notice and when to start apartment hunting if I plan to move.

A product launch countdown app for my phone where I can set the launch date and the main screen shows a bold, exciting ticking clock with the product name and a short teaser line I write myself. The feel should be polished and shareable, something that looks like a real pre-launch page so I could screenshot it and post it, with the design conveying energy and anticipation.

Create an album or book release countdown app for my phone where I enter the release date, the title, and the artist or author, and the app counts down with a mood that matches the creative work, whether that is moody and literary or punchy and musical. I want the design to feel like a fan-made teaser page, something with personality that I would actually keep open on my phone and show to other fans who are waiting too.

Build a space mission launch countdown app for my phone that counts down to an upcoming rocket launch with a look and feel pulled straight from mission control, think dark backgrounds, glowing countdown numbers, and that charged electric atmosphere of a real launch day. I want to enter the mission name and launch time and have the app feel genuinely epic every time I open it.

A word and character count tool on my phone that I can paste any text into and instantly see the total word count, character count, and a breakdown of which words show up the most, so I can check density without copying things to my laptop. I always run into the hassle of needing to verify text length and keyword repetition on the go, so a simple paste-and-see mobile tool would save me a lot of back and forth.

Make a duplicate line remover tool for my phone where I can paste in a messy list or block of text and the app automatically strips out any repeated lines or phrases and gives me back the cleaned-up version I can copy. I keep getting sent documents or notes with a ton of repetition and doing it manually on my phone is painful, so I just need something quick and no-fuss that handles it in one tap.

Build a text comparison tool for my phone where I paste two versions of a document or paragraph into two separate areas and the app highlights the differences between them so I can see exactly what changed. I always end up squinting at two things trying to spot edits manually and it takes forever on a phone screen, so having a highlighted diff view on mobile would cut out all that hassle.

An email subject line tester app on my phone where I type in two or three subject line options and get a quick side-by-side breakdown of which one is more likely to get opened, based on things like length, tone, and word choice. I spend way too long second-guessing subject lines before hitting send, so a simple tool that tells me which version reads better would take that decision off my plate.
